description: Mark the Platform secrets the spec leaves unmarked as x-sensitive. (1) CreateJWTTemplate and UpdateJWTTemplate inline `signing_key`, documented as "the custom signing private key to use when minting JWTs"; live create and update on 2026-10-02 accepted an RS256 PKCS#8 private key there. (2) PlatformApplicationTransferResponse.code is the claim code "shared with the recipient to claim the application"; it is a bearer credential for ownership of the application (live POST .../transfers on 2026-10-02 returned a 36-character UUID). (3) The ClaimAccountlessApplication request body's `token` is "the single-use claim token for the accountless application"; whoever holds it can take ownership of that application, so it is a credential on the request side. User `password` and `totp_secret` are already sensitive through convert's default name patterns, and instance `secret_key` already carries x-sensitive, so neither is patched here.
